Good — there *are* free, copy-paste ready React components and examples you can use (and adapt) for mouse cursor/eye-follow effects. Here are several, plus notes on what to check and how to pick the one that works for you. --- ### ✅ Some free components & examples - entity["software", "react-cursor-follow", 0]: An MIT-licensed React component library for cursor followers. citeturn0search0 entity_metadata["software","one-line","react-cursor-follow",0] - entity["software", "react-mouse-follower", 0]: A React + entity["software", "Framer Motion", 0]-based package for mouse follower effects. citeturn0search11 - entity["software", "react-animated-cursor", 0]: A React component for custom/animated cursors (not exactly “eyes follow mouse” but in the same ballpark). citeturn0search15 entity_metadata["software","one-line","react-animated-cursor",0] - entity["software", "animated-cursor-component (shadcn/ui)", 0] (via shadcn/ui): Free open source React component for custom cursor & follow effects. citeturn0search12 entity_metadata["software","one-line","animated-cursor-component (shadcn/ui)",0] - Example “eyes follow mouse” code (pure JS/HTML) that you can adapt into React: e.g. a CodePen “Eyes follow mouse” demo. citeturn0search8turn0search10 - A tutorial that shows how to build your own “eyes follow mouse” in React + Tailwind CSS. citeturn0search2 --- ### 🔍 What to check / pick based on your needs - **License**: Make sure it’s free (MIT, GPL) and clear for your project. - **Dependencies**: Some use Framer Motion, some are plain React + CSS/JS. If you already use Framer Motion, the Framer ones may integrate better. - **Effect you want**: - Do you want *eyes* (pupils tracking cursor) or just *cursor follower/custom cursor*? - Do you want the effect only in a section, or across the whole page? - **Performance / size**: A simple effect is better for production than a heavy animation package if you only need a small effect. - **Customization**: How easy it is to change radius of eye movement, styling, etc. - **Browser / Mobile support**: If you care about mobile/touch, check how it degrades. - **Integration**: How easy to drop into your React component tree, CSS/SCSS, hooks etc. --- ### 🛠 My Recommendation (for you) Since you said “free components I can copy-paste,” → I’d pick one of the ready ones (react-cursor-follow or react-mouse-follower) and use it out of the box. If I were you (student, want fast result) I’d do this: 1. Install `react-cursor-follow` (or whichever seems simpler). ```bash npm install react-cursor-follow ``` 2.
